data.long_meaning: The name Sisban is derived from the Arabic language, and it is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby boy. The name Sisban is a reminder of this noble virtue and encourages its bearer to embody this trait throughout his life.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Sisban also holds great spiritual significance as it reflects the essential Islamic principle of serving and helping others as an act of worship and obedience to Allah. By bearing the name Sisban, the child is being reminded of the importance of being a helpful and generous servant of Allah throughout his life. It is also a reminder of the hadith in which the Prophet (peace be upon him) said, "The best among you are those who have the best manners and characteristics" (Bukhari). The name Sisban, with its Arabic roots in 'help' and 'generous,' represents qualities that are highly valued in both the Islamic community and in the sight of Allah.
